--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local W = require(script.Parent.GameplayWidgets)
local Pets = require(RS.Shared.Gameplay.Definitions.PetDefinitions)
local Rarities = require(RS.Shared.Gameplay.Definitions.RarityDefinitions)
local Variants = require(RS.Shared.Gameplay.Definitions.VariantDefinitions)
local Garden = require(RS.Shared.Gameplay.Definitions.GardenDefinitions)
local PetMath = require(RS.Shared.Gameplay.PetMath)
local Appearance = require(RS.Shared.Gameplay.PetAppearance)

local M = {
	Mode = "Slots",
	DurationId = "GardenShift",
	SelectedPet = nil :: string?,
	PreviewCosmetic = "FlowerCrown" :: string,
	PreviewPet = nil :: string?,
	Busy = false,
	LastReady = {} :: { [string]: boolean },
	LastHarvest = -1,
}

local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(43, 137, 90)
local LEAF = Color3.fromRGB(85, 170, 95)
local WOOD = Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 70)
local CREAM = Color3.fromRGB(249, 247, 237)
local SUNNY = Color3.fromRGB(244, 188, 70)
local BERRY = Color3.fromRGB(226, 90, 110)
local PUMPKIN = Color3.fromRGB(240, 140, 30)

local function expeditionByUid(data: any, uid: string): any
	for _, entry in ipairs(data.GardenExpeditions or {}) do
		if type(entry) == "table" and entry.UID == uid then return entry end
	end
	return nil
end

local function findPet(data: any, uid: string): any
	for _, owned in ipairs(data.Pets or {}) do
		if owned.UID == uid then return owned end
	end
	return nil
end

local function previewFor(pet: any, durationId: string): number
	local def = Pets[pet.PetId]
	local rarity = def and def.Rarity or "Common"
	local mutation = Variants.Mutations[pet.Mutation]
	local duration = Garden.Durations[durationId]
	return Garden.Estimate(rarity, pet.Level or 1, (mutation and mutation.Power) or 1, pet.Shiny == true, pet.Prismatic == true, duration and duration.Seconds or 60)
end

local function previewRange(pet: any, durationId: string): (number, number)
	local base = previewFor(pet, durationId)
	return math.max(1, math.floor(base * 0.9)), math.max(1, math.floor(base * 1.09))
end

local function gardenPower(pet: any): number
	local def = Pets[pet.PetId]
	return Garden.RarityMult(def and def.Rarity or "Common")
end

local function timeLeft(entry: any): number
	return math.max(0, (entry.ReadyAt or 0) - os.time())
end

local function progressOf(entry: any): number
	local duration = math.max(1, entry.Duration or 60)
	local elapsed = duration - timeLeft(entry)
	return math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1)
end

local function formatTime(seconds: number): string
	seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	return string.format("%02d:%02d", math.floor(seconds / 60), seconds % 60)
end

local function isInGarden(): boolean
	local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	return (root.Position - Garden.RealmCenter).Magnitude < 90
end

local function sectionTitle(parent: Instance, text: string): Instance
	return W.Text(parent, text, UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 28), nil, 19)
end

local function progressBar(parent: Instance, frac: number, ready: boolean): Instance
	local track = W.New("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 14),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 228, 210),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, parent)
	W.Round(track, 7)
	local fill = W.New("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(frac, 0.03, 1), 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = ready and SUNNY or LEAF,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, track)
	W.Round(fill, 7)
	return track
end

local function bigButton(parent: Instance, text: string, size: UDim, pos: UDim?, callback: () -> (), color: Color3?): TextButton
	local b = W.Button(parent, text, size, pos, nil, color or GREEN)
	b.TextSize = 16
	b.Selectable = true
	if callback then b.Activated:Connect(function()
		if M.Busy then return end
		callback()
	end) end
	return b
end

local function header(ctx: any, content: Instance)
	local data = ctx.Data
	local harvest = (data.Currencies and data.Currencies.GardenHarvest) or 0
	local active = 0
	if type(data.GardenExpeditions) == "table" then active = #data.GardenExpeditions end
	local readyCount = 0
	for _, entry in ipairs(data.GardenExpeditions or {}) do
		if type(entry) == "table" and timeLeft(entry) <= 0 then readyCount += 1 end
	end
	-- Completion notification: toast once per newly-ready pet.
	for _, entry in ipairs(data.GardenExpeditions or {}) do
		if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.UID) == "string" then
			local ready = timeLeft(entry) <= 0
			if ready and not M.LastReady[entry.UID] then
				local pet = findPet(data, entry.UID)
				local def = pet and Pets[pet.PetId]
				if ctx.Notify then ctx.Notify("🌱 GARDEN READY — " .. (def and def.DisplayName or "Your pet") .. " finished foraging!") end
			end
			M.LastReady[entry.UID] = ready
		end
	end
	for uid in pairs(M.LastReady) do
		if expeditionByUid(data, uid) == nil then M.LastReady[uid] = nil end
	end
	local gainText = ""
	if M.LastHarvest >= 0 and harvest > M.LastHarvest then
		gainText = "  (+" .. tostring(harvest - M.LastHarvest) .. ")"
	end
	M.LastHarvest = harvest
 local hero = W.New("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 118), BackgroundColor3 = CREAM, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, content)
 W.Round(hero, 16)
 W.New("UIStroke", { Color = LEAF, Thickness = 2, Transparency = 0.4 }, hero)
 W.Text(hero, "🌱 PET GARDEN", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 30), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8), 22)
	W.Text(hero, "Harvest: " .. tostring(harvest) .. gainText, UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 26), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 38), 18, W.Color.Ink)
	W.Text(hero, "Expeditions: " .. tostring(active) .. " / 3" .. (readyCount > 0 and ("  ·  " .. tostring(readyCount) .. " ready!") or ""), UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 64), 15, W.Color.Muted)
	local inGarden = isInGarden()
	local destLabel = inGarden and "↩ RETURN TO KINGDOM" or "🌿 VISIT GARDEN"
	bigButton(hero, destLabel, UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 44), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0), function()
		M.Busy = true
		if inGarden then ctx.Request("ReturnGarden", {}) else ctx.Request("VisitGarden", {}) end
		task.delay(2, function() M.Busy = false; ctx.Refresh() end)
	end, WOOD)
	-- Sub-tabs.
	local tabs = W.New("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 48), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, content)
	local defs = { { "Slots", "🌱 Plots" }, { "Send", "➕ Send" }, { "Shop", "🎨 Shop" }, { "Style", "✨ Style" } }
	for i, d in ipairs(defs) do
		local selected = M.Mode == d[1]
		local b = W.Button(tabs, d[2], UDim2.new(0.24, 0, 1, 0), UDim2.fromScale((i - 1) * 0.253, 0), function()
			M.Mode = d[1]
			ctx.Refresh()
		end, selected and GREEN or W.Color.Muted)
		b.TextSize = 15
		b.Selectable = true
	end
end

local function slotCards(ctx: any, content: Instance)
	local data = ctx.Data
	sectionTitle(content, "Expedition plots")
	local bySlot: { any } = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(data.GardenExpeditions or {}) do
		if type(entry) == "table" then table.insert(bySlot, entry) end
	end
	table.sort(bySlot, function(a: any, b: any): boolean
		return (a.StartedAt or 0) < (b.StartedAt or 0)
	end)
	local readyCount = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(bySlot) do if timeLeft(e) <= 0 then readyCount += 1 end end
	if readyCount >= 2 then
		bigButton(content, "🌾 CLAIM ALL (" .. tostring(readyCount) .. ")", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 48), nil, function()
			M.Busy = true
			ctx.Request("ClaimAllExpeditions", {})
			task.delay(2, function() M.Busy = false end)
		end, SUNNY)
	elseif readyCount == 0 and #bySlot == 0 then
		W.Text(content, "Your garden is quiet... Send a pet to start gathering crops!", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 44), nil, 15, W.Color.Muted)
		bigButton(content, "➕ SEND PET", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 48), nil, function()
			M.Mode = "Send"
			ctx.Refresh()
		end)
	end
	for slot = 1, 3 do
		local entry = bySlot[slot]
		local card = W.Card(content, entry and 252 or 120)
		if not entry then
			W.Text(card, "Garden Plot " .. tostring(slot) .. " — EMPTY PLOT ➕", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 30), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10), 17)
			W.Text(card, "A cozy bed ready for a forager.", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 40), 13, W.Color.Muted)
			bigButton(card, "➕ Send a pet here", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 40), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 68), function()
				M.Mode = "Send"
				ctx.Refresh()
			end, LEAF)
			continue
		end
		local pet = findPet(data, entry.UID)
		local def = pet and Pets[pet.PetId]
		local duration = Garden.Durations[entry.DurationId or ""]
		local left = timeLeft(entry)
		local frac = progressOf(entry)
		local ready = left <= 0
		local lo, hi = 0, 0
		if pet then lo, hi = previewRange(pet, entry.DurationId or "SproutRun") end
		W.Text(card, "Garden Plot " .. tostring(slot) .. (ready and " — READY TO HARVEST! ✨" or ""), UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 26), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8), 15, ready and W.Color.Ink or W.Color.Muted)
		local model = pet and Appearance.Create(pet) or nil
		if model then W.Viewport(card, model, UDim2.fromOffset(92, 92), UDim2.fromOffset(6, 36)) end
		W.Text(card, def and def.DisplayName or (entry.PetId or "Pet"), UDim2.new(1, -116, 0, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(104, 36), 18)
		W.Text(card, (def and def.Rarity or "?") .. " · " .. (duration and duration.DisplayName or "?"), UDim2.new(1, -116, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(104, 64), 14, W.Color.Muted)
		W.Text(card, ready and "✅ Done!" or ("⏳ " .. formatTime(left) .. " left"), UDim2.new(1, -116, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(104, 88), 15, ready and GREEN or W.Color.Ink)
		if pet then
			W.Text(card, "Estimated: ~" .. tostring(lo) .. "–" .. tostring(hi) .. " Harvest", UDim2.new(1, -116, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(104, 110), 13, W.Color.Muted)
		end
		progressBar(card, frac, ready).Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 134)
		if ready then
			bigButton(card, "🌾 CLAIM", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 48), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 156), function()
				M.Busy = true
				ctx.Request("ClaimExpedition", { UID = entry.UID })
				task.delay(2, function() M.Busy = false end)
			end, SUNNY)
		else
			bigButton(card, "Recall early", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 44), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 156), function()
				local pct = math.floor(frac * 100)
				local approx = pet and math.floor(previewFor(pet, entry.DurationId or "SproutRun") * frac * 0.5) or 0
				local screen = script.Parent
				local overlay = W.New("Frame", { Name = "GardenRecallConfirm", Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.4), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.45), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = CREAM, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 90 }, screen)
				W.Round(overlay, 16)
				W.New("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(480, 300), MinSize = Vector2.new(280, 230) }, overlay)
				W.Text(overlay, "RECALL PET?", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 30), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10), 20)
				W.Text(overlay, "Progress: " .. tostring(pct) .. "% · You get ~" .. tostring(approx) .. " Harvest (half of earned).", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 60), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 44), 15, W.Color.Muted)
				local function close() overlay:Destroy() end
				local keep = W.Button(overlay, "KEEP FORAGING", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 44), UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -104), close, GREEN)
				keep.Selectable = true
				local recall = W.Button(overlay, "RECALL", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 44), UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -54), function()
					close()
					M.Busy = true
					ctx.Request("CancelExpedition", { UID = entry.UID })
					task.delay(2, function() M.Busy = false end)
				end, BERRY)
				recall.Selectable = true
			end, W.Color.Muted)
		end
		local ref = W.Button(card, "↻", UDim2.fromOffset(40, 30), UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 8), function() ctx.Refresh() end, W.Color.Muted)
		ref.TextSize = 14
		ref.Selectable = true
	end
	-- Expedition results note (crops are per-trip flavor, only Harvest persists).
	W.Text(content, "Crops (Carrot · Tomato · Pumpkin · Starberry · Moonmelon) are expedition results — only Harvest is saved.", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 44), nil, 12, W.Color.Muted)
end

local function eligibility(data: any, pet: any): (boolean, string)
	local equipped = table.find(data.EquippedPets or {}, pet.UID) ~= nil
	if equipped then return false, "Equipped — unequip to send." end
	if expeditionByUid(data, pet.UID) ~= nil then return false, "Already foraging." end
	if pet.Locked then return false, "Locked pet." end
	return true, ""
end

local function sendFlow(ctx: any, content: Instance)
	local data = ctx.Data
	sectionTitle(content, "➕ Send a pet")
	if type(data.GardenExpeditions) == "table" and #data.GardenExpeditions >= Garden.MaxActive then
		W.Text(content, "All 3 Garden plots are occupied. Claim or recall one first!", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 40), nil, 15, BERRY)
		return
	end
	W.Text(content, "Step 1 — pick a forager (rarer = more Harvest)", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 26), nil, 15)
	local sorted: { any } = {}
	for _, pet in ipairs(data.Pets or {}) do table.insert(sorted, pet) end
	table.sort(sorted, function(a: any, b: any): boolean
		local da, db = Pets[a.PetId], Pets[b.PetId]
		local ra, rb = da and Rarities[da.Rarity].Order or 0, db and Rarities[db.Rarity].Order or 0
		if ra ~= rb then return ra > rb end
		return PetMath.Power(a) > PetMath.Power(b)
	end)
	if #sorted == 0 then
		W.Text(content, "Hatch a pet first, then send it foraging!", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 34))
		return
	end
	local eligibleCount = 0
	for _, pet in ipairs(sorted) do
		local ok, _ = eligibility(data, pet)
		if ok then eligibleCount += 1 end
	end
	if eligibleCount == 0 then
		W.Text(content, "All available pets are equipped or already foraging.", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 40), nil, 15, W.Color.Muted)
	end
	local shown = 0
	for _, pet in ipairs(sorted) do
		if shown >= 10 then break end
		shown += 1
		local def = Pets[pet.PetId]
		if not def then continue end
		local ok, why = eligibility(data, pet)
		local selected = M.SelectedPet == pet.UID
		local card = W.Card(content, 132)
		if selected then
			W.New("UIStroke", { Color = GREEN, Thickness = 3, Transparency = 0.2 }, card)
		end
		local model = Appearance.Create(pet)
		if model then W.Viewport(card, model, UDim2.fromOffset(76, 76), UDim2.fromOffset(6, 10)) end
		W.Text(card, def.DisplayName, UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 26), UDim2.fromOffset(88, 8), 17)
		W.Text(card, def.Rarity .. " · Lv " .. tostring(pet.Level) .. " · Power " .. tostring(gardenPower(pet)) .. "x", UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(88, 34), 14, W.Color.Muted)
		if ok then
			local lo, hi = previewRange(pet, M.DurationId)
			W.Text(card, "~" .. tostring(lo) .. "–" .. tostring(hi) .. " Harvest", UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(88, 58), 14, W.Color.Ink)
			local b = W.Button(card, selected and "✓ Selected" or "Select", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 40), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 86), function()
				M.SelectedPet = pet.UID
				ctx.Refresh()
			end, selected and GREEN or LEAF)
			b.Selectable = true
		else
			W.Text(card, why, UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 44), UDim2.fromOffset(88, 58), 14, BERRY)
		end
	end
	W.Text(content, "Step 2 — pick a trip (longer = more Harvest)", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 26), nil, 15)
	for _, id in ipairs(Garden.DurationOrder) do
		local d = Garden.Durations[id]
		local disp = Garden.TripDisplay[id]
		local selected = M.DurationId == id
		local card = W.Card(content, 108)
		if selected then W.New("UIStroke", { Color = GREEN, Thickness = 3, Transparency = 0.2 }, card) end
		W.Text(card, d.DisplayName:upper() .. " · " .. d.Label:upper(), UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8), 17)
		W.Text(card, disp.Tagline .. " · Base: " .. disp.BaseLabel .. " · Best for " .. disp.BestFor .. ".", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 36), 13, W.Color.Muted)
		local b = W.Button(card, selected and "✓ Selected" or "Choose", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 36), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 66), function()
			M.DurationId = id
			ctx.Refresh()
		end, selected and GREEN or W.Color.Muted)
		b.Selectable = true
	end
	local pet = M.SelectedPet and findPet(data, M.SelectedPet) or nil
	if pet and (eligibility(data, pet) ~= true) then pet = nil end
	if pet then
		local def = Pets[pet.PetId]
		local d = Garden.Durations[M.DurationId]
		local lo, hi = previewRange(pet, M.DurationId)
		local card = W.Card(content, 150)
		W.Text(card, "Reward preview", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 26), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8), 17)
		W.Text(card, (def and def.DisplayName or "?") .. " · " .. (def and def.Rarity or "?") .. " · " .. d.DisplayName, UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 34), 14, W.Color.Muted)
		W.Text(card, "Harvest: " .. tostring(lo) .. "–" .. tostring(hi), UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 60), 18)
		W.Text(card, "Possible: Carrot · Tomato · Pumpkin · Starberry · Moonmelon", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 90), 13, W.Color.Muted)
		bigButton(content, "🌱 SEND (" .. d.Label .. ")", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 52), nil, function()
			M.Busy = true
			ctx.Request("StartExpedition", { UID = pet.UID, DurationId = M.DurationId })
			task.delay(2, function() M.Busy = false end)
		end)
	else
		W.Text(content, "Select an eligible pet above to unlock SEND.", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 30), nil, 14, W.Color.Muted)
	end
end

local function shopFlow(ctx: any, content: Instance)
	local data = ctx.Data
	local harvest = (data.Currencies and data.Currencies.GardenHarvest) or 0
	sectionTitle(content, "🎨 Garden shop — " .. tostring(harvest) .. " Harvest")
	if harvest <= 0 then
		W.Text(content, "Complete Garden expeditions to earn Harvest.", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 30), nil, 14, W.Color.Muted)
	end
	for _, id in ipairs(Garden.CosmeticOrder) do
		local def = Garden.Cosmetics[id]
		local owned = data.GardenCosmetics and data.GardenCosmetics[id] == true
		local selected = M.PreviewCosmetic == id
		local card = W.Card(content, 190)
		if selected then W.New("UIStroke", { Color = SUNNY, Thickness = 3, Transparency = 0.2 }, card) end
		local dummy = { PetId = "Bunny", Level = 1, Mutation = "Normal", Cosmetic = id }
		local model = Appearance.Create(dummy)
		if model then W.Viewport(card, model, UDim2.fromOffset(84, 84), UDim2.fromOffset(6, 10)) end
		W.Text(card, def.DisplayName, UDim2.new(1, -104, 0, 28), UDim2.fromOffset(96, 10), 18)
		W.Text(card, def.Description, UDim2.new(1, -104, 0, 40), UDim2.fromOffset(96, 38), 13, W.Color.Muted)
		W.Text(card, owned and "OWNED ✅" or (tostring(def.Cost) .. " Harvest"), UDim2.new(1, -104, 0, 24), UDim2.fromOffset(96, 76), 15, owned and GREEN or PUMPKIN)
		local row = W.New("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 44), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 132), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, card)
		local prev = W.Button(row, "Preview", UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 1, 0), nil, function()
			M.PreviewCosmetic = id
			M.Mode = "Style"
			ctx.Refresh()
		end, W.Color.Muted)
		prev.Selectable = true
		if owned then
			local eq = W.Button(row, "Equip", UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 1, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 0), function()
				M.PreviewCosmetic = id
				M.Mode = "Style"
				ctx.Refresh()
			end, GREEN)
			eq.Selectable = true
		else
			local buy = W.Button(row, "Buy", UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 1, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 0), function()
				M.Busy = true
				ctx.Request("BuyGardenCosmetic", { Id = id })
				task.delay(2, function() M.Busy = false end)
			end, SUNNY)
			buy.Selectable = true
		end
	end
end

local function styleFlow(ctx: any, content: Instance)
	local data = ctx.Data
	sectionTitle(content, "✨ Dress up a pet")
	local ownedList: { string } = {}
	for _, id in ipairs(Garden.CosmeticOrder) do
		if data.GardenCosmetics and data.GardenCosmetics[id] then table.insert(ownedList, id) end
	end
	if #ownedList == 0 then
		W.Text(content, "No cosmetics yet — trade Harvest in the Shop!", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 34), nil, 15, W.Color.Muted)
		bigButton(content, "Go to Shop", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 48), nil, function()
			M.Mode = "Shop"
			ctx.Refresh()
		end)
		return
	end
	if not table.find(ownedList, M.PreviewCosmetic) then M.PreviewCosmetic = ownedList[1] end
	local sorted: { any } = {}
	for _, pet in ipairs(data.Pets or {}) do table.insert(sorted, pet) end
	table.sort(sorted, function(a: any, b: any): boolean
		return tostring(a.UID) < tostring(b.UID)
	end)
	if #sorted == 0 then
		W.Text(content, "Hatch a pet first!", UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 30))
		return
	end
	if not M.PreviewPet or not findPet(data, M.PreviewPet) then M.PreviewPet = sorted[1].UID end

local Service = Knit.CreateService({ Name = "GardenExpeditionService", Client = {} })
local Data: any = nil
local returnSpots: { [Player]: CFrame } = {}
local claimLocks = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function expeditions(data: any): { any }
	if type(data.GardenExpeditions) ~= "table" then data.GardenExpeditions = {} end
	return data.GardenExpeditions
end

local function cosmetics(data: any): { [string]: boolean }
	if type(data.GardenCosmetics) ~= "table" then data.GardenCosmetics = {} end
	return data.GardenCosmetics
end

local function findExpedition(data: any, uid: string): (any, number)
	for i, entry in ipairs(expeditions(data)) do
		if type(entry) == "table" and entry.UID == uid then return entry, i end
	end
	return nil, 0
end

local function mutationPower(pet: any): number
	local entry = Variants.Mutations[pet.Mutation]
	return (entry and entry.Power) or 1
end

local function fullReward(pet: any, durationSeconds: number): number
	local def = PetDefs[pet.PetId]
	local rarity = def and def.Rarity or "Common"
	return Garden.Estimate(rarity, pet.Level or 1, mutationPower(pet), pet.Shiny == true, pet.Prismatic == true, durationSeconds)
end

local function grantPetXP(player: Player, data: any, pet: any, amount: number)
	if amount <= 0 or pet.Level >= Variants.MaxLevel then return false end
	pet.XP += amount
	local leveled = false
	while pet.Level < Variants.MaxLevel and pet.XP >= PetMath.RequiredXP(pet.Level) do
		pet.XP -= PetMath.RequiredXP(pet.Level)
		pet.Level += 1
		leveled = true
	end
	if pet.Level >= Variants.MaxLevel then pet.XP = 0 end
	return leveled
end

function Service:Start(player: Player, uid: string, durationId: string): (boolean, any)

function Service:ClaimInternal(player: Player, uid: string): (boolean, any)

	local data = Data:Get(player)
	if not data then return false, "Profile is loading" end

 if not entry then return false, "That expedition has already been claimed." end
 local now = os.time()
 if now < entry.ReadyAt then
  return false, "Still foraging (" .. tostring(entry.ReadyAt - now) .. "s left)"
 end
	local pets = Knit.GetService("PetService")
	local pet, petIndex = pets:FindOwned(data, uid)

		Data:Publish(player, "GardenExpeditions")

 Data:Publish(player, "GardenExpeditions")

 end)

 local root = Guard.Alive(player)

 returnSpots[player] = nil

 if look.Magnitude < 0.01 then look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end

local Garden = {}

Garden.MaxActive = 3
Garden.Currency = "GardenHarvest"

Garden.Durations = {
	SproutRun = { Id = "SproutRun", DisplayName = "Sprout Run", Seconds = 60, Label = "1 min" },

}

Garden.TripDisplay = {
 SproutRun = { Tagline = "Quick expedition", BaseLabel = "Low", BestFor = "fast farming" },
 GardenShift = { Tagline = "Balanced expedition", BaseLabel = "Medium", BestFor = "steady harvest" },
 GrandHarvest = { Tagline = "Long expedition", BaseLabel = "High", BestFor = "big hauls" },
}

Garden.RealmCenter = Vector3.new(2000, 30, 2000)

Garden.RarityMultiplier = {
	Common = 1,
	Uncommon = 1.5,
	Rare = 2.2,
	Epic = 3.2,
	Legendary = 5,
	Mythical = 8,
	Secret = 12,
}

Garden.CropNames = { "Carrot", "Tomato", "Pumpkin", "Starberry", "Moonmelon" }

Garden.Cosmetics = {
	FlowerCrown = { Id = "FlowerCrown", DisplayName = "Flower Crown", Cost = 40, Description = "A ring of garden blooms." },
	StrawberryHat = { Id = "StrawberryHat", DisplayName = "Strawberry Hat", Cost = 90, Description = "Freshly picked berry cap." },
	LeafyAura = { Id = "LeafyAura", DisplayName = "Leafy Aura", Cost = 150, Description = "Swirling garden leaves." },
	GoldenBloom = { Id = "GoldenBloom", DisplayName = "Golden Bloom", Cost = 300, Description = "A radiant golden harvest glow." },
	RainbowSprout = { Id = "RainbowSprout", DisplayName = "Rainbow Sprout", Cost = 500, Description = "The garden's rarest shimmer." },
}
Garden.CosmeticOrder = { "FlowerCrown", "StrawberryHat", "LeafyAura", "GoldenBloom", "RainbowSprout" }

function Garden.RarityMult(rarity: string): number
	return Garden.RarityMultiplier[rarity] or 1
end

function Garden.LevelMult(level: number): number
	return 1 + (math.max(1, level) - 1) * 0.03
end

-- Longer expeditions and higher rarity pets earn more. Deterministic preview.
function Garden.Estimate(rarity: string, level: number, mutationPower: number, shiny: boolean, prismatic: boolean, seconds: number): number
	local base = math.max(1, seconds) / 60 * 8
	local total = base * Garden.RarityMult(rarity) * Garden.LevelMult(level or 1) * (mutationPower or 1)
	if shiny then total *= 1.5 end
	if prismatic then total *= 2 end
	return math.max(1, math.floor(total))
end

-- Flavor split of a total harvest across crop names. Sums back to total.
function Garden.SplitCrops(total: number, seed: number): {{ Name: string, Amount: number }}
	local names = Garden.CropNames
	local parts = math.min(#names, 2 + (seed % 3))
	local remaining = total
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, parts do
		local amount = 0
		if i == parts then
			amount = remaining
		else
			amount = math.max(1, math.floor(total / parts * (0.7 + ((seed + i * 37) % 60) / 100)))
			amount = math.min(amount, remaining - (parts - i))
		end
		remaining -= amount
		table.insert(out, { Name = names[((seed + i - 1) % #names) + 1], Amount = amount })
	end
	return out
end

return table.freeze(Garden)
